mc_questions.question: Which responsibility belongs to the Spring IoC container?
answers: Creating objects and supplying their dependencies
Compiling Java source into bytecode
Translating JPQL directly into SQL
Packaging an application into a container image

mc_questions.question: What is a Spring Boot starter?
answers: A dependency descriptor that groups commonly used libraries
A source-code generator for controller classes
A runtime replacement for the JVM
A database migration script executed at startup

mc_questions.question: Which statement best distinguishes Spring Boot from Spring Framework?
answers: Spring Boot adds opinionated setup and auto-configuration on top of Spring
Spring Boot replaces dependency injection with static factories
Spring Framework can build only command-line applications
Spring Framework is included only for production deployments

mc_questions.question: What does it mean when Spring Boot auto-configuration backs off?
answers: It avoids providing a default when the application defines the relevant bean
It keeps its default bean and marks the application bean as secondary
It creates both beans and injects them in registration order
It postpones the default bean until the application bean fails

mc_questions.question: Why is the main Spring Boot application class normally placed in a root package?
answers: So component scanning naturally covers the application's subpackages
So Maven can locate the compiled JAR without configuration
So every class automatically becomes a Spring bean
So database entities no longer need mapping annotations

mc_questions.question: An application has Spring MVC on the classpath but starts without an embedded web server. The main class is a plain class with a main method. Which change is most appropriate?
answers: Add @SpringBootApplication and call SpringApplication.run
Add @Entity and call the repository directly
Add @Transactional to the main method
Add @RestControllerAdvice to the main class
